description: The National Street Gazetteer (NSG) is the authoritative database of all streets in England and Wales, covering public roads, private streets and assets such as footpaths, cycleways and byways, with 1,486,432 streets supported by 18,865,643 features. It was created to coordinate street works and is used by highway authorities, utilities and others for street works notifications, highway maintenance, traffic management and planning. Local highway authorities maintain Local Street Gazetteers under British Standard 7666, and upload changes with Additional Street Data such as road centre lines, ownership, reinstatement requirements, height, weight and width restrictions and direction of travel; GeoPlace quality-assures the data against several hundred criteria and integrates them. Coverage is England and Wales. Access: the full NSG goes to licensed users by web download, while INSPIRE-compliant street data are offered for download and listed on data.gov.uk under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: the full dataset needs a licence, and the open INSPIRE subset is narrower. It supports road network models with restrictions and ownership, street works and disruption analysis, and routing for freight with height and weight limits, and complements OS Open Roads and the National Highways network model catalogued here.
licence: licensed (full NSG); CC-BY (INSPIRE subset as listed on data.gov.uk)
